# NCAAF Tuesday MACtion - Nov 3

## Pick
- **Buffalo/Miami (OH) Over 44.5 (-110), 0.5u (8 PM).** Two models over the number: SportsLine projects the over as the value side 64% of the time; Dimers projects Miami 27-19 (46 points, ~54% over 44.5). Raw ~59% -> 55.3% after the 0.58 factor vs 52.4%. Small: Covers' analyst expects a run-heavy under (Heavner 6.0 YPA, Wright 5.3 YPA), and our totals record is weak (unders 1-3; first over bet on two-model agreement).

## Passes
- Miami (OH) -6.5: Dimers 54% cover, SportsLine side hidden, Covers on Buffalo +6.5. Pass.
- Ohio -11.5/-14 at Akron: Dimers projects 32-19 (cover 53%) but its best bet is Akron +11.5 at the price; the line has moved to -14. Pass.
- Ohio/Akron Over 50.5: SportsLine 54 projected (61%), Dimers 53.6% - two models, but -114 price leaves under 1% edge. Lean.

picks.summary: SportsLine (64% over) and Dimers (46 projected) both above 44.5.
